subject: Web Development
title: The Rise of Frontend Architecture
description: A 60-second lesson on The Rise of Frontend Architecture.

hook.text: As web apps grew complex, spaghetti jQuery code became impossible to maintain.

buildup.text: Backbone.js arrived in 2010, bringing structure with models, views, and routers.

discovery.text: For the first time, frontend code had architecture — patterns borrowed from server-side.

twist.text: Backbone was lightweight but verbose. You wrote a lot of boilerplate for simple features.

climax.text: It opened the door for Angular, React, and every framework that followed.

punchline.text: Backbone taught JavaScript to think in structure.

quiz.question: What pattern did Backbone.js bring to frontend code?
